name: quadriceps stretch on box
description: A quad stretch with the back foot resting on a box or bench, opening the front of the thigh.
instructions: Stand facing away from a box or bench and place the top of one foot on it behind you.
Stand tall on the front leg with a soft knee.
Tuck your pelvis and lower the hips slightly until you feel a stretch in the front of the thigh.
Hold a support for balance if needed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
